title: The release act stays with the owner; Review P4 closes the phase
question: Who creates and pushes v1.0.0, and does P4 end with a review item?

options.text: P4 ends with a qualified, frozen candidate (green release-preflight 1.0.0, gate.md) and a read-only Review P4; the owner tags v1.0.0, pushes it and enables split/Packagist after the plan.
Tag by the owner, no Review P4.
The last P4 item tags and pushes v1.0.0 under an explicit owner grant, after a review.

context: P4 design session 2026-10-14. Owner answer M17: «Тег — владелец; Review P4 да (Recommended)».
decision: A — P4 ends with a qualified, frozen candidate (green release-preflight 1.0.0, gate.md) and a read-only Review P4; the owner tags v1.0.0, pushes it and enables split/Packagist after the plan.
rationale: Owner M17 chose the recommended option; tagging publishes a release and is outward-facing.
consequences: No P4 item creates or pushes a tag in the repository; pushes are limited to origin feat/1.0-candidate under the owner gate CI-PUSH (P4.2, P4.8).
P4.9 Review P4 is a read-only review item; P4.8's result names the exact tag commands for the owner.
